summary: End-to-end verification of the Admin CMS bug fix (Add/Edit modals for Products/Categories/Slides now open using undefined sentinel). All targeted flows PASS via Playwright + backend API checks. Product create with category + edit + duplicate + delete work; public catalogue reflects changes (no pricing anywhere). Slides bug fix works including validation-preserves-form-data toast, image upload via hidden file input, LIVE→HIDDEN toggle, delete. Auto-slug on category (Louvers → louvers) works. Upload endpoint returns URL and /api/files serve returns 200. Homepage hero renders. No JS page errors. All QA test artifacts (product, slide, category) cleaned up; Corten Rust HPL 8mm which was accidentally overwritten during the first edit test was restored to original state via API.

minor.issue: Requires full ProductCreate body (no partial update). Sending only {"name": ...} returns 422 for missing category_id. Consider PATCH or partial-update model.

issues: renders with empty src='' when main_image is empty causing React warning ('empty string passed to src attribute'). Recommend conditional render or placeholder.

missing_testids.issue: Duplicate and Delete buttons on product cards have no data-testid (only Edit has edit-{id}). Add duplicate-{id} and delete-{id} for testability.
FileUpload used in category & slide forms has no testid prop (product form passes testids). Consider adding testid for consistency.
Category row delete/edit buttons don't appear to expose {id}-scoped testids based on grep. Cleanup script had to fall back to xpath ancestors, which is brittle.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add data-testid="duplicate-{id}" and data-testid="delete-{id}" on product cards for automated testing robustness
OPTIONAL: Guard to only render when URL truthy (removes React empty-src warning)
OPTIONAL: Support partial update PUT /api/products (or a PATCH endpoint) so front-end reset flows don't need full payload
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIX correctly implemented: editing state now uses `undefined` sentinel for closed vs `null` for creating new; modal render condition `editing !== undefined` works in AdminProducts/Categories/Slides.
AdminSlides.save() correctly returns early on validation errors WITHOUT closing modal, so heading/subheading/order form state is preserved for the user (verified in UI test).
AdminCategories autoSlug useEffect works: typing 'Louvers' produced slug 'louvers' automatically (verified).
Toggle enable/disable on slide uses PUT /slides/{id} with full body — OK.
MINOR: PUT /api/products requires full body (Pydantic model without Optional). Not a blocker but limits API ergonomics.
seed_data_creation: Temporary QA data created and cleaned up: category 'Louvers' (deleted), product 'QA Test Louver Panel v2' (deleted), duplicate 'QA Test Louver Panel v2 (Copy)' (deleted), slide 'QA Slide Test' (deleted). Also: during the initial edit test, product 'Corten Rust HPL 8mm' was accidentally renamed; restored to original values via authenticated PUT /api/products/{id}. Final data set matches pre-test state (11 products, 6 categories, 3 slides).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All admin modal bug fixes verified in iteration 2. Reusable data-testids on admin cards (add-product, product-form-modal, pf-name, pf-category, pf-save, pf-cancel, edit-{id}, admin-product-{id}, add-slide, slide-form-modal, sf-heading, sf-save, slide-toggle-{id}, slide-delete-{id}, add-category, category-form-modal, cf-name, cf-slug, cf-save). NOTE: no duplicate-{id}/delete-{id} testids on product cards yet — scope via `[data-testid=admin-product-{id}]` and get_by_role('button', name='Duplicate'/'Delete'). Public routes: /products?category={slug}, product detail from card click. Uploads: POST /api/upload → returns {url} served at /api/files/{path}. Slide FileUpload has no exposed testid; use `[data-testid=slide-form-modal] input[type=file]` via set_input_files.
